event: Operational early-closure landmark, not exact physiological onset: first sample after smoothed peak below peak - fraction*(peak-hold) for 3 consecutive samples; peak uses centered 3-point median for event localization only. Hold is median from stored stable boundary to end. Distance is original recorded distance at landmark.
grouping: Recording batches identified by timestamp: fast 16:17, slow A 19:19, slow B 19:32. No model training, no data edits. These are selected training data, descriptive analysis only.
